'''December 2000 Las Vegas tournament (30 December)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Las Vegas, NV on 30 December 2000. [[Matt Berta]] won it. It is known from Brandon Gravo's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1581">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-las-vegas-12-30-2000d1581/ las-vegas-12-30-2000], DeckTech (Brandon "Droid Pimp" Gravo, 31 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-31-las-vegas-12-30-2000d1581/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Las Vegas, NV
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Matt Berta]]
